factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Income Statement shows Operating profit 5,751 (2026) vs 5,961 (2025); Net finance income 444 (2026) vs 1,652 (2025); Income tax expense 1,870 (2026) vs 1,322 (2025).

factual_claims.claim: Revenue trends differed by business and market.

factual_claims.claim: Retail revenue increased 13.6% to EUR 13.548 million, raising its share of total sales to 47.4%, while wholesale revenue declined 9.1% to EUR 14.934 million.

factual_claims.claim: Russia remained the largest market, generating EUR 15.767 million, down 0.6% in euros and 7.8% in local currency.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Belarus sales increased 6.4% to EUR 9.046 million, or 2.7% in local currency.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Geographical segments table shows Belarus revenue 9,046 (2026) vs 8,500 (2025) +6.4%. Belarus Economic Outlook section states local currency sales increased by 2.7%.

factual_claims.claim: Sales in Ukraine and the Baltics also declined.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Geographical segments table shows Ukraine revenue 15 (2026) vs 36 (2025) -58.3%; Baltics revenue 484 (2026) vs 581 (2025) -16.7%.

factual_claims.claim: The Group and its franchise partners operated 547 stores at period-end, including 135 directly operated stores.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation improved considerably, with operating cash flow rising 96.6% to EUR 6.842 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows shows Net cash flow from operating activities 6,842 (2026) vs 3,481 (2025) +96.6%.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents increased 87.4% from year-end to EUR 12.443 million, while short-term deposits stood at EUR 38.707 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 2 shows Cash and cash equivalents 12,443 (2026) vs 6,639 (2025) +87.4%; Short-term deposits over 3 months 38,707 (2026).

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased 5.1% to EUR 98.603 million, and equity attributable to parent-company shareholders rose 6.1% to EUR 81.479 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows Total assets 98,603 (2026) vs 93,847 (2025) +5.1%; Equity attributable to equity holders of Parent 81,479 (2026) vs 76,768 (2025) +6.1%.

factual_claims.claim: Inventory decreased to EUR 29.702 million, and current liabilities declined.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 4 shows Inventories 29,702 (2026) vs 31,237 (2025). Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows Total current liabilities 8,290 (2026) vs 9,292 (2025).

factual_claims.claim: Overall, the Group maintained strong cash and equity positions and improved gross profitability, but weaker financing results and higher operating costs led to a marked decline in net profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Summary points from Management Report and Selected Financial Indicators: strong cash/equity positions, improved gross margin (55.6% vs 53.1%), but decreased net finance income and higher operating costs drove net profit down 31.2%.
